intro: Live warehouses, manufacturing plants and distribution centers across the Mid-Atlantic — joint repair, full-depth restoration, coating systems and certified line marking, sequenced so the rest of the floor kept running.

projects.title: Full-depth removal and replacement
projects.alt: Excavator breaking out failed concrete in a facility yard
projects.description: Section loss taken back to sound concrete before placement. Where the slab has genuinely lost load capacity, a flexible repair is the wrong answer and rigid restoration is the right one.

projects.title: Placement and finish
projects.alt: Crew placing and screeding new concrete from a mixer truck
projects.description: The same area rebuilt and finished flush with the surrounding slab so wheel loads transfer across the joint instead of hammering an exposed edge.

projects.title: Aisle restriping — before
projects.alt: Warehouse aisle with worn white floor markings before restriping
projects.description: Worn markings in a live distribution aisle. Faded traffic lanes become a safety finding long before they become a cosmetic one.

projects.title: Aisle restriping — after
projects.alt: The same warehouse aisle with fresh yellow line marking
projects.description: Traffic lanes, pedestrian routes and work zones reinstated in high-visibility yellow using coatings rated for forklift and pallet-jack traffic.

projects.title: Resin coating over prepared substrate
projects.alt: Technician applying a resin floor coating in a manufacturing bay
projects.description: Coating going down after profiling and moisture assessment — the step that decides whether the floor is still bonded in three years.

projects.title: Finished seamless floor
projects.alt: Finished seamless industrial floor coating with yellow guard rails
projects.description: Seamless, cleanable and chemical-resistant, back under forklift traffic on the agreed window.

projects.title: Coated pedestrian walkway
projects.alt: Blue coated walkway ramp inside a distribution center
projects.description: Colour-coded pedestrian route with a slip-resistant finish, separating foot traffic from the forklift lane.

projects.title: Loading dock edge repair
projects.alt: Technician repairing a concrete dock edge at a loading bay
projects.description: Impact-damaged dock edges rebuilt one bay at a time so the door rotation never fully stopped.

projects.title: Interior slab repair in a live plant
projects.alt: Technician finishing a concrete repair along a warehouse wall
projects.description: Spall and delamination repair worked around racking and production, with the surrounding area handed straight back.
